biggest_catch: Business accounts only, opened IN A BRANCH. The $800 tier requires parking $20,000 for days 31-90 after account opening. Account must be opened between 02/03/2026 and 10/30/2026 (offer ends 2026-10-30).
catches: New-to-business-deposit customer; open an Access Business Banking Checking or Pro Access Business Banking Checking account with a minimum opening deposit of $100 between 2/3/2026 and 10/30/2026 at any Old National banking center (in-branch only).

$800 tier: deposit a total of $20,000 or more within 30 days of account opening; maintain a balance of $20,000 or more during days 31-90; enroll in Small Business Digital Banking and log in within 30 calendar days of account opening.

$400 tier: deposit a total of $4,000 or more within 30 days of account opening; maintain a balance of $4,000 or more during days 31-90; enroll in Small Business Digital Banking and log in within 30 calendar days of account opening.
Qualifying deposits include teller/ATM/mobile deposits, wires, and external transfers from accounts at other financial institutions; transfers between Old National accounts do not qualify.
Balance reviewed daily during days 31-90 to confirm the minimum required balance is maintained.
Must maintain a positive/balance-greater-than-zero account at the time of bonus processing.
Bonus paid within 120 days of account opening per the official offer page (aggregators report between days 100-120).
Geography per aggregators: IA, IL, IN, KY, MI, MN, ND, TN, WI (in branch only).
